content: Homage to the glorious Lord of Speech.Within the bindu of the Hayagrīva lineage, the lotus face blossomed,And the melodious neighing, heard together, reached the pinnacle of Akaniṣṭha;Like the wind shaking leaves from a tree, the pride of the chief of the desire realm was cast down,I bow to that Vajra-glory who pledged to be his servant.O Protector, when you dwelt in the bloom of youth,You filled the glorious Sangphu, the grove of the joy of the thirty-three,With the great drum-sound of teaching, debating, and composing,Making even the crescent moon rejoice in the sky.Then, before the Rigdzin Zhönnu Gyalpo, where the flower of the Dharma-way was in full bloom,When you respectfully took up the bee-like conduct of seeking the sweet nectar of secret, well-spoken meanings,You obtained the honey of the many scriptures of the Three Classes and Nine Spaces with the feet of your intellect,Becoming like the summer rain clouds, heavy with the weight of abundant water.In the deep, dark depthsOf the great ocean of supreme jewels, glory abides;You too, through your hidden yogic conduct,Became the glory of the teachings of the Supreme Vehicle.Though you cast aside all material wealth like grass, you possessed infinite riches of meditative concentration.Though you relied on the solitude of peaceful forests, the dakinis and vidyadharas gathered like clouds.Though you abandoned the ninefold activities, your oceanic deeds were spontaneously accomplished.Though you hid the treasures of the qualities of the paths and stages, the fame of your name spread to the ends of the earth.Though your profound wisdom is difficult to fathom,You were highly skilled in the methods of teaching,And because you were moved by your own compassion,You revealed it through a hundred lights of elegant sayings.When you taught the Heart Essence at the sacred site of Chimphu, the Lake-born Vajra revealed his face,And Vajravarahi personally bestowed empowerment and prophesied many hidden sacred sites.The dakinis and oath-bound protectors took the offerings in their manifest forms, and with sounds of joy,They shook the world greatly, and those who saw it were busy beating drums of wonder.Though it is difficult to know, no matter how much one examines it,The crown-ornament of the Buddha’s vehicle,You, like the sun revealing forms,Performed the kindness of making it clearly manifest.Your profound, clear, stainless, and vastly expansive wisdom is like the sky, the youthful prime of supreme knowledge,Which appears in the form of letters upon the precious mirror-surface of the volumes,Like the gathered essence of the beauty of the ocean of elegant sayings known as the Seven Treasuries,A wondrous, unprecedented, and fortunate nectar for the eyes of the wise, appearing even now.Merchants desiring wealth enter the ocean of water,But the wise enter your ocean of scriptures.The ocean is filled with the arrival of various precious gems,While your speech is rich with the glory of various profound meanings.In this era of strife and degeneration, you are the guide of the world who dwells in the high ground,Connecting the staircase of the jewel of elegant sayings with a firm foundation,Calling out as if to say, "Come quickly, following the lineage of learned and accomplished masters,"To you, the peerless compassionate one, I prostrate.From now until enlightenment, throughout all my lifetimes,May I be born in the stainless lotus of your lineage,In a body of Dharma free from dust,And may I cause the teachings of the essence of the supreme vehicle to flourish.In the vajra-abode, you are the guardian of the teachings that reveal the path of luminosity,Wherever you dwell, you are the emanated image of the threefold Buddha,Touching all with your majesty that surpasses a hundred suns,You transform this Jambudvīpa into a single mass of light.This is the "Messenger of Spring," a praise to the omniscient Dharma King, composed by Jikmé Tenpé Nyima, who holds the final place in the lineage of the Heart-Essence, when, upon carefully examining the elegant sayings of the Pith Instruction Heart-Essence, a great sense of wonder arose in his mind and he composed this song of devotion.
